Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Added replay player debuffs with timers and Active Effects display modes. Added configurable 10-second, 30-second, and 1-minute Review lead-ups. Reorganized Options and Customize, added optional Fun Mode interactions, improved unsupported replay arena framing, and made timeline HP loss easier to distinguish.
